statement: An author never approves their own work: decisions and TAIL exemptions require an independent approver (author differs from approver; never session self-decisions under D-325 or proposed records), and scopes involving money or other people require Daniel (D-360).
note: D-352 (Torre por delegação do Daniel 22/11/2026): replaces inert STD-train-ownership-refusals as active roles-and-responsibilities evidence for CTRL-ssdf-po.2 (SSDF PO.2). Exercised on decisions and TAIL exemptions by active_tailoring() and management_findings() in scripts/lib/model.py.
